headline: Clear Kagoshima sightseeing; monitor distant In-fa and Sakurajima ash
summary: Sunny, dry conditions favor the Sengan-en excursion. In-fa is strengthening far southeast of Japan but no significant typhoon threat to the remaining ports is indicated. Sakurajima's Level 3 volcanic alert remains in force.

details: Kagoshima hourly forecast shows sunshine and 0 mm precipitation at 9 AM, noon, 3 PM and 6 PM; no expected rain window during the 8:30–11:45 AM Sengan-en Garden & Museum excursion.
Temperatures rise from around 19°C at 9 AM to 22–23°C by afternoon. Take sun protection and a light layer for the cooler morning.
Beppu tomorrow: approximately 23°C / 14°C (73°F / 57°F), becoming cloudy; about 24% chance of rain, mainly late at night. Daytime tour likely dry.

sources.label: Yahoo Japan · Kagoshima hourly forecast (Oct 27, 9 PM issue)

items: Today, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM — Kagoshima port call.

Tomorrow, 10:00 AM–6:00 PM — Beppu port call.
Tomorrow, 11:00 AM–2:00 PM — Private Beppu Hell tour: geothermal 'hells', monkeys and lunch, Beppu, Oita. Rain expected mainly late night, not during tour.

details: Rain chance about 24%, mainly late Thursday night; the 11 AM–2 PM private Beppu Hell tour should be largely dry.
The seven Beppu Jigoku geothermal attractions are generally open 8 AM–5 PM. Expect walking between outdoor hot-spring features.
October 30 is a sea day; rain is forecast in Beppu Friday morning, but sea conditions require ship-specific updates.

typhoon.status: Monitor distant In-fa; no significant threat to upcoming ports
typhoon.summary: JMA advisory October 28, 6:45 AM JST: Very strong Typhoon In-fa at 14.8°N, 160.5°E in the Marshall Islands, 950 hPa, westward 15 km/h, sustained winds 50 m/s (180 km/h), gusts 70 m/s (252 km/h). It intensified from 965 hPa and 45 m/s yesterday morning. Former Champi is no longer a typhoon.
details: JMA forecasts In-fa west-northwest toward the Mariana Islands by October 30 and Ogasawara waters around November 1; the timing and position of a turn remain uncertain beyond several days.

Kagoshima October 28 and Beppu October 29: no significant direct typhoon threat indicated. October 30 sea day: monitor marine forecasts and ship announcements. Tokyo October 31: no confirmed storm disruption, with the forecast center still far south.
No Regent-confirmed cancellations, route changes or shore-excursion adjustments found. Forecast risk is not a confirmed itinerary change; follow Seven Seas Explorer announcements.

headsUp: Sakurajima volcano remains at JMA Eruption Alert Level 3 (restricted access within approximately 2 km of Minamidake and Showa craters). JMA's October 26 bulletin recorded 12 eruptions from October 23–26, including four explosive events. Ashfall is possible downwind; no closure of the scheduled Sengan-en excursion has been verified.
No other major verified disruption affecting today's port call identified.
worthALook: Recurring / scheduled: Sengan-en Garden, Shimadzu residence and neighboring museum, 9700-1 Yoshino-cho, 9 AM–5 PM; already part of your morning excursion.
Recurring: Shiroyama Observatory, Shiroyama-cho, accessible via Kagoshima City View bus; panoramic views of Sakurajima and the city, best if visibility is clear.
Recurring: Tenmonkan shopping arcades, central Kagoshima, open-access district with restaurants and shirokuma shaved ice; CenTerrace shops generally 10 AM–8 PM.
Recurring: Kagoshima Aquarium, 3-1 Honkoshinmachi, 9:30 AM–6 PM (last entry 5 PM); indoor alternative if volcanic ash affects outdoor plans.
